title: CampusBite — Student Campus Food Ordering & Pickup
idea: CampusBite is a campus-focused food ordering and pickup platform designed for university students, campus dining halls, and independent food trucks parked on university grounds.

overview.projectName: CampusBite — Student Campus Food Ordering & Pickup
overview.summary: CampusBite is a campus-focused food ordering and pickup platform designed for university students, campus dining halls, and independent food trucks parked on university grounds.
overview.problemStatement: During peak breaks between lecture hours, campus dining halls and food trucks experience extreme congestion, resulting in 20-30 minute queues and missed lunches for students.
goals: Reduce student waiting time between classes to under 5 minutes
Allow kitchen staff to pace preparation using a real-time order queue
Provide dining administrators real-time visibility into vendor health and sales
scope: Student mobile-responsive menu browsing and pre-ordering
Vendor kitchen display board with live status transitions
outOfScope: Integration with external third-party food delivery aggregators (e.g. UberEats)

features.name: Browse Vendors & Daily Menus
features.description: Students can view active campus dining locations, check open hours, browse item categories, and filter by dietary restrictions.

features.name: Meal Ordering & Time-slot Reservation
features.description: Select meal items, customize options (e.g. spice level, allergy flags), select pickup window, and submit payment via campus card or card.

features.name: Live Order Status Tracking
features.description: Track the preparation stage of placed orders (Received, In Kitchen, Ready for Pickup, Collected) with real-time alerts.

features.name: Vendor Menu & Kitchen Display
features.description: Kitchen staff can update daily item availability, toggle sold-out items, and advance order statuses from a high-contrast touch screen.

features.name: Campus Vendor Administration
features.description: Campus administration can approve new dining vendors, audit food safety permits, and review campus dining operational metrics.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Enrolled student with valid campus credentials ordering meals on campus.

roles.name: Kitchen Staff / Vendor Operator
roles.description: Food stall or cafeteria staff managing menu availability and fulfilling orders.

roles.name: Campus Dining Administrator
roles.description: University official overseeing all dining facilities and vendor contracts.

requirements.description: The system shall list all authorized campus dining locations with opening hours, menu categories, and dietary tags.
acceptanceCriteria: Vendor list renders in under 1 second
Dietary filter filters vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free items instantly
Closed vendors are clearly indicated with reopening times

requirements.description: Students shall be able to place scheduled pre-orders with customized options and payment authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: Order submission validates item availability in real time
Unique order confirmation ID is generated with estimated pickup slot
Receipt is stored in student order history

requirements.description: The system shall notify students immediately when their order transitions to 'Ready for Pickup'.
acceptanceCriteria: In-app status updates within 2 seconds of vendor action
Order details show pickup counter number and pickup code

requirements.description: Vendors shall have a kitchen view allowing 1-click status transitions and instantaneous item 86/sold-out toggling.
acceptanceCriteria: Marking item sold-out immediately disables it from new student carts
Order queue orders cards by requested pickup time

requirements.description: Administrators shall review vendor applications and approve or suspend campus vending privileges.
acceptanceCriteria: Suspended vendors are hidden from student app immediately
Audit log records administrative actions with timestamp

requirements.description: The platform shall support up to 500 concurrent order requests at the 12:00 PM and 1:00 PM class transition peaks.
acceptanceCriteria: 99th percentile response time for order submission remains under 800ms
Zero overselling occurs due to race conditions

roadmap.title: Phase 1: Core Architecture & Vendor Directory
roadmap.description: Setup MongoDB persistence, basic user profiles, vendor catalog, and menu browsing.
tasks: Create collections for users, vendors, and menu items
Implement vendor list and menu detail REST endpoints
completionCriteria: Students can view verified vendors and menus on mobile devices

roadmap.title: Phase 2: Ordering & Payment Integration
roadmap.description: Cart management, time-slot pickup selection, campus meal card payment flow.
tasks: Implement atomic order creation with inventory validation
Build checkout page with pickup time picker
completionCriteria: Students can complete an order and receive a validated pickup confirmation

roadmap.title: Phase 3: Kitchen Display System & Real-Time Alerts
roadmap.description: Kitchen tablet UI for order fulfillment and live status updates.
tasks: Implement status mutation API and student notification dispatch
Add sold-out 86 toggle for menu items
completionCriteria: Kitchen staff can transition orders from Received to Ready in 1 click

roadmap.title: Phase 4: Admin Management & Auditing
roadmap.description: Dining administration console for vendor registration, hygiene certification, and reports.
tasks: Implement vendor approval workflows and suspension controls
Build admin metrics dashboard for order volumes
completionCriteria: Administrators can audit and toggle vendor operational status

assumptions.description: Student identities will be verified via university Single Sign-On (SSO / OAuth2) providing a verified campus ID.
assumptions.reason: Prevents anonymous spam orders and links student accounts to campus dining card IDs.

assumptions.description: All menu prices and transactions use campus dining meal points or domestic currency in cents.
assumptions.reason: Simplifies monetary math to integer cents without floating point precision issues.

openQuestions.question: Does the campus meal card service support a synchronous HTTP REST API for debiting funds at checkout time, or does it require batch clearing?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Determines whether order creation can immediately mark orders paid or requires an asynchronous pending verification state.

classification.reason: Project focuses on software architecture, frontend screens, database schema design, and backend REST APIs.

teamRoles.responsibility: Student mobile-responsive web app, menu browser, and live pickup UI
Spring Boot REST services, concurrency control, and MongoDB persistence
High-contrast kitchen display board and student ordering flows
Automated order flow testing and peak concurrency validation

estimatedCost.basis: 4 engineers over 6–8 weeks, cloud hosting, and SMS notification gateways.
estimatedCost.disclaimer: Approximate estimate based on the supplied requirements.

resources.name: Managed MongoDB Database
resources.purpose: Transactional persistence for orders and menus

architecture.description: Single-page React client communicating with a Spring Boot REST API layer backed by MongoDB persistence.

frontend.reason: Lightweight virtual DOM and fast mobile bundle delivery for students walking between lectures
frontend.tradeOffs: Client-side routing requires separate SSR configuration if SEO is required

backend.reason: Enterprise stability, strong concurrency primitives, and clean separation of concerns
backend.tradeOffs: Higher initial memory footprint than micro-frameworks

database.reason: Flexible document structure well suited for nested meal customizations, menus, and dynamic line items
database.tradeOffs: Requires careful application-level indexing for high-volume transactions

deployment.reason: Containerized reproducible execution with predictable cost
deployment.tradeOffs: Requires container maintenance and manual orchestration

testing.reason: Full verification from isolated business rules to browser ordering flows
testing.tradeOffs: Browser tests require browser binary provisioning in CI

optionalServices.reason: Fast in-memory cache for vendor daily menu and peak session tokens
optionalServices.tradeOffs: Adds an additional stateful service to monitor
